Tidewatch Backup Agent: Operations Runbook
This runbook describes how to install, configure and troubleshoot the Tidewatch backup agent on Linux servers. It is written for the on-call engineers of the platform team.
1. Installation
Prerequisites
A 64-bit Linux host with systemd 245 or later
At least 2 GB of free disk space for the local cache
Outbound HTTPS access to the backup endpoint
Install the agent with the bootstrap script and check that the service has started.
$ curl -fsSL https://example.org/tidewatch/install.sh | sh\n$ sudo systemctl enable --now tidewatch\n$ tidewatch status
2. Configuration
The agent reads its settings from /etc/tidewatch/agent.yaml. A minimal file looks like this.

agent:
  name: edge-backup-01
  interval: 15m
targets:
- path: /var/lib/app/data\n  exclude: ["*.tmp", "cache/"]\nretention:
daily: 7\nweekly: 4\nmonthly: 12

KeyTypeDefaultDescriptionagent.intervalduration30mTime between two backup runstargets[].pathstringnoneDirectory to protect; requiredtargets[].excludelist[]Glob patterns that are skippedretention.dailyinteger7Number of daily snapshots kept

Retention policy
Snapshots are pruned after every successful run. To change the policy, follow these steps.
1. Edit the retention block in the configuration file.
2. Validate and reload the agent:
a. Run tidewatch config check and read the output.
b. Run sudo systemctl reload tidewatch.
3. Confirm the new schedule with tidewatch status.
3. Troubleshooting
Every failed run writes one structured line to the journal. A typical entry is shown below.
{"ts":"2026-05-02T02:15:09Z","level":"error","code":"E214",\n "target":"/var/lib/app/data","msg":"upload timed out after 120s"}

CodeMeaningFirst actionE101Configuration file could not be parsedRun tidewatch config checkE214Upload timed outCheck network route and proxy settingsE307Target directory is not readableFix permissions for the tidewatch userE412Cache volume is fullFree space or raise the cache limit
Escalation
If two consecutive runs fail with the same code, escalate in this order.
– Page the platform on-call engineer.
– Open an incident ticket and attach the last 200 journal lines.
– Inform the data owner if the gap exceeds 24 hours.
4. Support
Questions about this runbook can be sent to the platform team mailbox. Please include the agent version printed by the status command.
$ tidewatch version\ntidewatch 2.8.1 (build 4f9c2d1)
